objective.metric: independently decoded pooled squared error against the original BF16 arrays in their original Gate-row, Up-row, and Down-column coordinates

exact_symmetry.function_identity: D'*(silu(G'*x) elementwise_mul U'*x) = D*(silu(G*x) elementwise_mul U*x)

metric_compatibility.reason: The frozen score requires the decoder to restore original coordinate labels. A canonical/reordered payload alone identifies an orbit element but not its original labeling.
metric_compatibility.canonical_sort_is_not_a_recovery_rule: Sorting decoder-visible reconstructed neurons can reproduce a canonical order, but no decoder-visible datum maps that canonical rank back to the original arbitrary row/column index.
metric_compatibility.payload_steganography_rule: If permutation information is embedded in codeword choices rather than a named side stream, those choices still consume rate and must be charged.
metric_compatibility.eligible_repair: serialize the factoradic rank of P inside the same expert frame, decode residuals in path order, then scatter all three roles back to original coordinates before MSE scoring
metric_compatibility.permutation_read: inline in the one expert frame; it adds bytes but no second object read

eligible_codec.predictor: the immediately preceding neuron in encoded path order
decode_order: read the one local frame and the one shared manifest page
decode the first Gate/Up/Down neuron as an anchor
decode each following joint residual and retain only the previous joint neuron
scatter Gate and Up rows and Down columns through P inverse into the original coordinate arrays

coefficient_modes.name: diag3_fp16_oracle_bridge
coefficient_modes.claim: exact FP16 bridge ledger only; the source oracle uses exact FP64 fits and does not claim this finite mode preserves its gain

coefficient_modes.name: full3x3_fp16_oracle_bridge
coefficient_modes.claim: strong favorable bridge ledger; coefficient quantization must be scored before promotion

coefficient_modes.name: diag3_fixed_nibble
coefficient_modes.alphabet: one frozen decoder-resident 16-value procedural alphabet; no learned uncharged table

coefficient_modes.name: full3x3_fixed_nibble
coefficient_modes.alphabet: one frozen decoder-resident 16-value procedural alphabet; no learned uncharged table

stage0_dense_envelope.description: For every expert and role, grant an exact free dense 768-dimensional neuron-axis KLT and continuous ideal reverse waterfilling. Three independently chosen dense bases are strictly more flexible than one shared permutation and a banded same-role predictor.
stage0_dense_envelope.uncertainty: delete-one-expert jackknife combined in quadrature with control Monte Carlo SE
stage0_dense_envelope.claim_boundary: This is a decisive second-order opportunity screen for ordering/prediction, not a converse for higher-order nonlinear codes.

stage1_pair_envelope_only_if_stage0_surv.description: Compute all 768*767 ordered within-expert pairs. Fit one exact 3x3 cross-role regression from the predecessor's Gate/Up/Down rows to the target's three rows.
stage1_pair_envelope_only_if_stage0_surv.pair_objective: tr(C * inverse(S_predecessor) * C^T), where C=X_target*X_predecessor^T and X has three 2048-coordinate role rows
stage1_pair_envelope_only_if_stage0_surv.degrees_of_freedom: nine coefficients only; selected coefficients are explicitly included in every physical ledger and never treated as free in a codec claim
stage1_pair_envelope_only_if_stage0_surv.relaxed_upper_bound: each target independently chooses its best non-self predecessor; predecessor reuse, cycles, and the missing anchor are deliberately allowed
stage1_pair_envelope_only_if_stage0_surv.legal_construction: maximum-weight non-self cycle cover followed by deterministic weakest-edge cuts and path concatenation

controls.construction: For every expert and neuron separately, match all three role means and the exact centered 3x3 Gate/Up/Down Gram. Randomize only the centered orientation in the 2048-coordinate subspace.
controls.why_stronger_than_global_moment_matching: It preserves every neuron energy, role covariance, mean, and heteroskedasticity that an encoder-selected ordering could otherwise exploit generically.

numeric_backend.small_assignment: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment after copying only the 768x768 score matrix to host

rate_and_read.cold_page_formula: (ceil(frame_bytes/4096)+1)*4096/frame_bytes; +1 is a pessimistic uncached shared-manifest page

required_before_payload: source-free CuPy calibration and independent receipt audit
stage1 relaxed and legal-path survival after all inline side bits
separately authorized finite coefficient/index and residual stream
independent decode into original coordinates and byte-derived rate/read audit
